resources.string: The tone starts quiet and rises to full in about 10 seconds. It ends just as loud, the vibration starts at once, and your alarm volume is not changed.
Where the spoken line is heard
An alarm always plays its tone and vibrates. This decides only where the one spoken line is said.
The line is said wherever the sound is going, the phone\'s speaker included.
The line is said only when a headset is connected, so that it stays private. Without one, the tone and the vibration still ring.
Your data: save a copy or erase everything
Everything stays on this phone unless a feature you turn on says otherwise.
